html:
<div class="lifeaudit-root">
<style>
.navbar{
    display:none;
}
.web-footer{
    display:none;
}
/* ===== LIFE AUDIT COMMAND CENTER — shadow-DOM safe (no CSS vars) ===== */
.lifeaudit-root *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
.lifeaudit-root{font-family:'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;background:#F3FAF4;color:#152418;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
.lifeaudit-root button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.lifeaudit-root .num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.lifeaudit-root input,.lifeaudit-root select,.lifeaudit-root textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:12.5px;border:1.5px solid #DCE9DE;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 10px;background:#fff;color:#152418;outline:none}
.lifeaudit-root input:focus,.lifeaudit-root select:focus{border-color:#43A047}

.la-hdr{
    /*background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0F3D1E,#1B5E20 70%,#2E7D32);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(15,61,30,.25)*/
    display:none;
}
.la-hdr-in{padding:12px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.la-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.la-mark{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#1B5E20;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:18px}
.la-company-title{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;color:#FFFFFF!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#FFFFFF!important;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.la-company-title small{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#DDF5E1!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#DDF5E1!important}
.la-brand-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px}
.la-healthcare-link{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5);background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  color:#FFFFFF!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#FFFFFF!important;
  border-radius:7px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.2;text-decoration:none!important;transition:.18s
}
.la-healthcare-link:hover{background:#FFFFFF;color:#14501F!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#14501F!important;text-decoration:none!important}
.la-live{margin-left:auto;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);padding:6px 13px;border-radius:99px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.la-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:#66BB6A;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(102,187,106,.7);animation:lapulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes lapulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(102,187,106,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(102,187,106,0)}}
.la-who{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);padding:6px 13px;border-radius:99px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}

.la-tabs{padding:14px 18px 0;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.la-tab{border:1.5px solid #DCE9DE;background:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:9px 18px;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:#14501F;transition:all .15s}
.la-tab:hover{border-color:#66BB6A}
.la-tab.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2E7D32,#1B5E20);color:#fff;border-color:#1B5E20;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(27,94,32,.3)}
.la-tab .b{background:#C62828;color:#fff;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;padding:1px 7px;margin-left:6px;font-weight:800}

.la-wrap{padding:16px 18px 30px}
.la-view{display:none}.la-view.on{display:block}
.la-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #DCE9DE;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,61,30,.06),0 4px 14px rgba(15,61,30,.07);padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px}
.la-card h3{font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#0F3D1E;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.la-kgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.la-kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid #DCE9DE;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 15px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,61,30,.06)}
.la-kpi b{display:block;font-size:21px;font-weight:800;color:#14501F}
.la-kpi b.r{color:#C62828}.la-kpi b.a{color:#E65100}.la-kpi b.bl{color:#1565C0}
.la-kpi span{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5F6F63}
.la-lbl{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5F6F63;margin-bottom:4px}

.la-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px}
.la-tbl th{background:#F3FAF4;color:#14501F;text-align:left;padding:8px 9px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.9px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;border-bottom:2px solid #DCE9DE;white-space:nowrap}
.la-tbl td{padding:8px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEF4EF;vertical-align:middle}
.la-tbl tr:hover td{background:#F3FAF4}
.la-pill{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.la-p-g{background:#E8F5E9;color:#14501F}.la-p-r{background:#FDECEA;color:#C62828}
.la-p-a{background:#FFF3E0;color:#E65100}.la-p-b{background:#E3F2FD;color:#1565C0}.la-p-gr{background:#ECEFF1;color:#546E7A}
.la-btn{border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 20px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
.la-btn-g{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2E7D32,#1B5E20);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(27,94,32,.3)}
.la-btn-o{background:#fff;color:#1B5E20;border:1.5px solid #43A047}
.la-btn-r{background:#fff;color:#C62828;border:1.5px solid #F2B8B5}
.la-btn-sm{padding:6px 13px;font-size:11.5px;border-radius:8px}
.la-btn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.la-hbar{height:7px;border-radius:99px;background:#E8F5E9;overflow:hidden;flex:1;min-width:60px}
.la-hbar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#43A047,#1B5E20)}
.la-hbar i.r{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#EF5350,#C62828)}.la-hbar i.a{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#FFB74D,#E65100)}

.la-asec{border:1px solid #DCE9DE;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.la-asec.crit{border-color:#F2B8B5}
.la-asec-h{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F3FAF4,#fff);border:none;padding:12px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#0F3D1E;text-align:left}
.la-asec.crit .la-asec-h{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#FDECEA,#fff)}
.la-asec-h .w{background:#1B5E20;color:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:10.5px;padding:3px 9px;font-weight:800}
.la-asec-h .gs{margin-left:auto;font-weight:800;color:#1B5E20;font-size:13.5px}
.la-asec-h .car{transition:transform .2s;color:#2E7D32;font-size:12px;margin-left:8px}
.la-asec.open .la-asec-h .car{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.la-asec-b{display:none;padding:4px 12px 12px}
.la-asec.open .la-asec-b{display:block}
.la-itbl th{font-size:9.5px}
.la-itbl td{padding:7px 8px}
.la-itbl .q{max-width:400px}
.la-itbl select.rt{padding:5px 8px;font-weight:700;border-radius:7px;font-size:11.5px}
.la-itbl input{width:100%;min-width:90px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:11.5px}
.la-evidence-wrap{min-width:220px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.la-evidence-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.la-file-label{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  border:1px solid #A5D6A7;background:#F3FAF4;color:#14501F;
  border-radius:7px;padding:5px 9px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;
  cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap
}
.la-file-label:hover{background:#E8F5E9}
.la-file-label input{display:none!important}
.la-evidence-link{
  display:inline-block;max-width:155px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap;color:#1565C0;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;
  text-decoration:none
}
.la-evidence-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.la-evidence-empty{font-size:10px;color:#87968B}
.la-file-remove{
  border:0;background:#FDECEA;color:#C62828;border-radius:6px;
  padding:4px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800
}
.la-evidence-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;width:100%}
.la-evidence-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;max-width:100%;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid #E2ECE4;border-radius:7px;background:#FAFCFA}
.la-evidence-item .la-evidence-link{flex:1;max-width:175px}
.la-evidence-count{font-size:9.5px;color:#607166;font-weight:800}
.la-evidence-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;width:100%}
.la-open-all{border:1px solid #90CAF9;background:#E3F2FD;color:#0D47A1;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.la-open-all:hover{background:#BBDEFB}
.la-uploading{opacity:.55;pointer-events:none}
.la-topic-modal{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10020;background:rgba(8,35,14,.55);
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px
}
.la-topic-modal.on{display:flex}
.la-camera-modal{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10040;background:rgba(5,24,10,.78);
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px
}
.la-camera-modal.on{display:flex}
.la-camera-dialog{
  width:min(760px,98vw);max-height:94vh;overflow:auto;background:#FFFFFF;
  border:1px solid #CFE1D2;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.42)
}
.la-camera-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #E5EFE7
}
.la-camera-head h3{margin:0!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#0F3D1E}
.la-camera-body{padding:14px 16px}
.la-camera-stage{
  position:relative;width:100%;min-height:260px;background:#07140A;
  border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center
}
.la-camera-stage video{
  display:block;width:100%;max-height:66vh;object-fit:contain;background:#07140A
}
.la-camera-status{
  position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:10px;padding:7px 10px;
  border-radius:8px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.58);color:#FFFFFF;font-size:11px;
  font-weight:700;text-align:center;pointer-events:none
}
.la-camera-foot{
  display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid #E5EFE7;background:#FAFCFA
}
.la-camera-button{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .la-camera-modal{padding:8px}
  .la-camera-dialog{width:100%;max-height:98vh}
  .la-camera-stage{min-height:240px}
  .la-camera-foot .la-btn{flex:1;min-width:105px}
}
.la-topic-dialog{
  width:min(680px,100%);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;
  border:1px solid #CFE1D2;border-radius:16px;
  box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.32)
}
.la-topic-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  padding:15px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #E5EFE7
}
.la-topic-head h3{margin:0!important;font-size:15px!important}
.la-topic-close{
  width:32px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#F1F5F2;
  color:#35523B;font-size:18px;font-weight:900
}
.la-topic-body{padding:17px 18px}
.la-topic-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 150px;gap:12px}
.la-topic-field{margin-bottom:12px}
.la-topic-field textarea{width:100%;min-height:82px;resize:vertical}
.la-topic-field input,.la-topic-field select{width:100%}
.la-topic-check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.la-topic-check input{width:auto}
.la-topic-foot{
  display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;padding:13px 18px;
  border-top:1px solid #E5EFE7;background:#FAFCFA
}
.la-topic-note{
  border:1px solid #BBDEFB;background:#F2F8FE;color:#164E7A;
  border-radius:9px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.45;
  margin-bottom:13px
}
@media(max-width:620px){.la-topic-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.rt.full{background:#E8F5E9;color:#14501F;border-color:#66BB6A}
.rt.half{background:#FFF3E0;color:#E65100;border-color:#FFCC80}
.rt.zero{background:#FDECEA;color:#C62828;border-color:#F2B8B5}
.la-crit{background:#C62828;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;padding:2px 6px;margin-left:6px}

.la-scorebar{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#14501F,#2E7D32);color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,61,30,.3);margin-bottom:14px}
.la-scorebar .big{font-weight:800;font-size:26px}
.la-scorebar .lb{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:1.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#BFE3C4;font-weight:700}
.la-grade{font-weight:800;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:99px;font-size:13px;background:#fff;color:#14501F}
.la-grade.warn{background:#FFE0B2;color:#E65100}.la-grade.bad{background:#FFCDD2;color:#C62828}

.la-sw{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:40px;height:22px;flex:none}
.la-sw input{opacity:0;width:0;height:0;position:absolute}
.la-sl{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#CFD8DC;border-radius:99px;transition:.2s;cursor:pointer}
.la-sl:before{content:"";position:absolute;height:16px;width:16px;left:3px;top:3px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;transition:.2s}
.la-sw input:checked+.la-sl{background:#2E7D32}
.la-sw input:checked+.la-sl:before{transform:translateX(18px)}

.la-ctl-columns{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:22px;
  align-items:start
}
.la-ctl-panel{
  min-width:0;
  margin:0!important;
  padding:20px 24px 18px!important;
  border:1px solid #D9E6DC!important;
  border-radius:8px!important;
  background:#FFFFFF!important;
  box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(23,58,32,.06)!important
}
.la-ctl-panel h3{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin:0 0 7px!important;
  color:#153B1D;
  font-size:15px!important;
  font-weight:900!important
}
.la-ctl-head-note{
  min-height:48px;
  margin:0 0 4px;
  color:#52665A;
  font-size:11.5px;
  line-height:1.55
}
.la-ctl-list{
  display:block!important
}
.la-ctl-row{
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:row!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:space-between!important;
  gap:18px!important;
  min-height:80px!important;
  padding:12px 8px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-bottom:1px dashed #D9E6DC!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}
.la-ctl-row:last-child{
  border-bottom:0!important
}
.la-ctl-row:hover{
  background:#FAFCFA!important
}
.la-ctl-row .nm{
  display:block!important;
  flex:1 1 auto!important;
  min-width:0;
  color:#102F17;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1.35
}
.la-ctl-title{
  display:block;
  white-space:normal;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere
}
.la-ctl-meta{
  display:block;
  margin-top:5px;
  color:#5C6F62;
  font-size:10.8px;
  font-weight:500;
  line-height:1.3
}
.la-branch-master{
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:row!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:space-between!important;
  gap:18px!important;
  min-height:68px;
  margin:6px 0 2px!important;
  padding:12px 10px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-radius:10px!important;
  background:#F1F8F2!important
}
.la-branch-master .txt{
  flex:1;
  min-width:0;
  color:#103B19;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1.35
}
.la-branch-master .txt small{
  display:none!important
}
.la-branch-grid{
  display:block!important
}
.la-branch-tile{
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:row!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  justify-content:space-between!important;
  gap:18px!important;
  min-height:67px!important;
  padding:10px 8px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-bottom:1px dashed #D9E6DC!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}
.la-branch-tile:last-child{
  border-bottom:0!important
}
.la-branch-tile:hover{
  background:#FAFCFA!important
}
.la-branch-tile.off{
  background:transparent!important;
  opacity:.58
}
.la-branch-label{
  display:block;
  flex:1;
  min-width:0;
  color:#102F17;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1.35;
  white-space:normal
}

/* Larger switches, limited to the Control Panel only. */
.la-ctl-columns .la-sw{
  position:relative!important;
  display:inline-block!important;
  flex:0 0 52px!important;
  width:52px!important;
  height:30px!important;
  margin-left:auto!important
}
.la-ctl-columns .la-sw input{
  position:absolute!important;
  width:0!important;
  height:0!important;
  opacity:0!important
}
.la-ctl-columns .la-sl{
  position:absolute!important;
  inset:0!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;
  background:#C9D4CC!important;
  cursor:pointer!important;
  transition:.2s!important;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.04)
}
.la-ctl-columns .la-sl:before{
  content:""!important;
  position:absolute!important;
  left:4px!important;
  top:4px!important;
  width:22px!important;
  height:22px!important;
  border-radius:50%!important;
  background:#FFFFFF!important;
  transition:.2s!important;
  box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.22)
}
.la-ctl-columns .la-sw input:checked + .la-sl{
  background:#287F31!important
}
.la-ctl-columns .la-sw input:checked + .la-sl:before{
  transform:translateX(22px)!important
}


.la-topic-ctl-panel{
  margin-top:18px!important
}
.la-topic-ctl-note{
  margin:0 0 14px;
  color:#52665A;
  font-size:11.5px;
  line-height:1.55
}
.la-topic-ctl-sec{
  border:1px solid #DCE9DE;
  border-radius:11px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#FFFFFF
}
.la-topic-ctl-head{
  width:100%;
  border:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#F3FAF4,#FFFFFF);
  padding:11px 13px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  text-align:left;
  color:#123C1A;
  font-size:12.5px;
  font-weight:900
}
.la-topic-ctl-head .meta{
  margin-left:auto;
  color:#5F6F63;
  font-size:10.5px;
  font-weight:700
}
.la-topic-ctl-head .car{
  color:#2E7D32;
  transition:transform .2s
}
.la-topic-ctl-sec.open .la-topic-ctl-head .car{
  transform:rotate(180deg)
}
.la-topic-ctl-body{
  display:none;
  padding:4px 12px 10px
}
.la-topic-ctl-sec.open .la-topic-ctl-body{
  display:block
}
.la-topic-ctl-row{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:14px;
  padding:10px 4px;
  border-bottom:1px dashed #D9E6DC
}
.la-topic-ctl-row:last-child{
  border-bottom:0
}
.la-topic-ctl-row.off{
  opacity:.58;
  background:#FAFBFA
}
.la-topic-ctl-question{
  flex:1;
  min-width:0;
  color:#152418;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:800;
  line-height:1.4
}
.la-topic-ctl-question small{
  display:block;
  margin-top:3px;
  color:#5F6F63;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:600
}
.la-topic-setup-warning{
  border:1px solid #FFCC80;
  background:#FFF8ED;
  color:#8A4B00;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:12px 14px;
  font-size:11.5px;
  line-height:1.55
}

@media(max-width:1000px){
  .la-ctl-columns{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
    gap:16px

  // ---- REST helper: works with or without the Desk frappe.call bundle ----

  // ---- date helpers: fall back to plain JS if frappe.datetime absent ----
  function today() {
    if (FR.datetime && FR.datetime.get_today) return FR.datetime.get_today();

    var current = new Date();
    var pad = function (value) {
      return String(value).padStart(2, "0");
    };

    return current.getFullYear() + "-" +
      pad(current.getMonth() + 1) + "-" +
      pad(current.getDate());
  }

  function dateStringFromParts(year, monthIndex, day) {
    var pad = function (value) {
      return String(value).padStart(2, "0");
    };

    return year + "-" +
      pad(monthIndex + 1) + "-" +
      pad(day);
  }

  function parseDateString(value) {
    var parts = String(value || "").split("-");

    if (parts.length !== 3) {
      return new Date();
    }

    return new Date(
      parseInt(parts[0], 10),
      parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1,
      parseInt(parts[2], 10)
    );
  }

  function addDaysToDateString(value, days) {
    var date = parseDateString(value);
    date.setDate(date.getDate() + days);

    return dateStringFromParts(
      date.getFullYear(),
      date.getMonth(),
      date.getDate()
    );
  }

  function reviewAuditDateFilter(rangeValue) {
    var range = String(rangeValue || "all");
    var todayValue = today();
    var currentDate = parseDateString(todayValue);
    var year = currentDate.getFullYear();
    var month = currentDate.getMonth();

    if (range === "today") {
      return todayValue;
    }

    if (range === "yesterday") {
      return addDaysToDateString(todayValue, -1);
    }

    if (range === "this_month") {
      return [
        "between",
        [
          dateStringFromParts(year, month, 1),
          dateStringFromParts(
            year,
            month,
            new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate()
          )
        ]
      ];
    }

    if (range === "last_month") {
      var lastMonthDate = new Date(year, month - 1, 1);
      var lastYear = lastMonthDate.getFullYear();
      var lastMonth = lastMonthDate.getMonth();

      return [
        "between",
        [
          dateStringFromParts(lastYear, lastMonth, 1),
          dateStringFromParts(
            lastYear,
            lastMonth,
            new Date(lastYear, lastMonth + 1, 0).getDate()
          )
        ]
      ];
    }

    if (range === "this_year") {
      return [
        "between",
        [
          dateStringFromParts(year, 0, 1),
          dateStringFromParts(year, 11, 31)
        ]
      ];
    }

    return null;
  }
  var fmtD = function (d) {
    if (!d) return "\u2014";
    if (FR.datetime && FR.datetime.str_to_user) return FR.datetime.str_to_user(d);
    var x = new Date(d);
    if (isNaN(x)) return d;
    return x.toLocaleDateString("en-IN",
      { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
  };

  var fmtDT = function (d) {
    if (!d) return "\u2014";
    var x = new Date(d);
    if (isNaN(x)) return d;
    return x.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
      day: "2-digit",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
      hour: "2-digit",
      minute: "2-digit",
      hour12: true
    });
  };

  var fmtPeriod = function (d) {
    if (!d) return "\u2014";
    var x = new Date(d);
    if (isNaN(x)) return d;
    return x.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
      month: "long",
      year: "numeric"
    });
  };

  function fmtCompactAuditDate(value) {
    var parts = String(value || "").split("-");

    if (parts.length !== 3) {
      return fmtD(value);
    }

    return parts[2].padStart(2, "0") + "-" +
      parts[1].padStart(2, "0") + "-" +
      parts[0].slice(-2);
  }

  function monthLabelFromKey(key) {
    var parts = String(key || "").split("-");
    if (parts.length !== 2) return key || "—";

    var date = new Date(
      parseInt(parts[0], 10),
      parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1,
      1
    );

    if (isNaN(date)) return key || "—";

    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
      month: "short",
      year: "2-digit"
    });
  }

  function auditPercentageForGrowth(audit) {
    var percentage = parseFloat(
      audit && audit.percentage
    );

    if (!isNaN(percentage)) {
      return percentage;
    }

    var total = parseFloat(
      audit && audit.total_score
    ) || 0;
    var maximum = parseFloat(
      audit && audit.max_score
    ) || 0;

    return maximum > 0
      ? total / maximum * 100
      : 0;
  }

  /*
   * Always shows the latest three CALENDAR months. Months without a
   * completed audit display "No audit" instead of disappearing.
   */
  function branchThreeMonthGrowth(branch) {
    var branchKey =
      normaliseBranchUserKey(branch);

    var rows = (
      S.growthAudits || []
    ).filter(function (audit) {
      return (
        normaliseBranchUserKey(
          audit.branch
        ) === branchKey &&
        String(
          audit.audit_status || "Draft"
        ).toLowerCase() !== "draft"
      );
    });

    var monthMap = {};

    rows.forEach(function (audit) {
      var key =
        String(
          audit.audit_date || ""
        ).slice(0, 7);

      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(key)) {
        return;
      }

      if (!monthMap[key]) {
        monthMap[key] = {
          total: 0,
          count: 0
        };
      }

      monthMap[key].total +=
        auditPercentageForGrowth(audit);

      monthMap[key].count += 1;
    });

    var now = new Date();
    var months = [];

    for (var offset = 2; offset >= 0; offset -= 1) {
      var monthDate = new Date(
        now.getFullYear(),
        now.getMonth() - offset,
        1
      );

      var monthKey =
        monthDate.getFullYear() +
        "-" +
        String(
          monthDate.getMonth() + 1
        ).padStart(2, "0");

      var saved =
        monthMap[monthKey];

      months.push({
        key: monthKey,
        label: monthDate.toLocaleDateString(
          "en-IN",
          {
            month: "short",
            year: "2-digit"
          }
        ),
        value: saved && saved.count
          ? Math.round(
              saved.total /
              saved.count *
              10
            ) / 10
          : null,
        count: saved
          ? saved.count
          : 0
      });
    }

    var available =
      months.filter(function (month) {
        return month.value != null;
      });

    var delta = null;

    if (available.length >= 2) {
      delta = Math.round(
        (
          available[available.length - 1].value -
          available[0].value
        ) * 10
      ) / 10;
    }

    return {
      months: months,
      available: available,
      delta: delta
    };
  }

  function branchThreeMonthGrowthText(branch) {
    var growth =
      branchThreeMonthGrowth(branch);

    var monthText =
      growth.months.map(function (month) {
        return month.label +
          ": " +
          (
            month.value == null

                "% (" +
                month.count +
                " audit" +
                (
                  month.count === 1

                    : "s"

                ")"

    var deltaText;

    if (growth.delta == null) {
      deltaText =
        "Growth needs completed audits in at least two months";
    } else {
      deltaText =
        "Growth: " +
        (
          growth.delta > 0
            ? "+"
            : ""
        ) +
        growth.delta +
        " percentage points";
    }

    return monthText + " | " + deltaText;
  }

  function branchThreeMonthGrowthHtml(branch) {
    var growth =
      branchThreeMonthGrowth(branch);

    var monthsHtml =
      growth.months.map(function (month) {
        var hasValue =
          month.value != null;

        return '<div class="la-growth-month' +
          (
            hasValue
              ? ''
              : ' no-data'

          '" title="' +
          esc(
            hasValue
              ? month.count +
                " completed audit" +
                (

          '<span class="m">' +

          '<span class="v num">' +
            (

    var deltaClass = "na";

      "Need audits in 2 months";

    if (growth.delta != null) {
      if (growth.delta > 0) {
        deltaClass = "up";
        deltaText =

    return '<div class="la-growth-cell" title="' +

      '<div class="la-growth-months">' +

      return Promise.resolve(audit);

    }).then(function (files) {
      files = (files || []).filter(function (file) {
        return !!String(file.file_url || "").trim();
      });

      if (!files.length) return audit;

      var urlToRow = {};
      var evidenceRows = [];

      (audit.ratings || []).forEach(function (row) {
        var rowFiles = parseEvidenceAttachments(row);
        if (rowFiles.length) evidenceRows.push(row);

        rowFiles.forEach(function (item) {
          urlToRow[item.file_url] = row;
        });
      });

      var currentRow = null;
      var pendingBeforeFirstMatch = [];

      files.forEach(function (file) {
        var fileUrl = String(file.file_url || "").trim();
        var matchedRow = urlToRow[fileUrl];

        if (matchedRow) {
          currentRow = matchedRow;

          if (pendingBeforeFirstMatch.length) {
            var restored = parseEvidenceAttachments(currentRow);
            pendingBeforeFirstMatch.forEach(function (pendingFile) {
              restored.push(pendingFile);
            });
            setEvidenceAttachments(currentRow, restored);
            pendingBeforeFirstMatch = [];
          }
          return;
        }

        var extraFile = {
          file_url: fileUrl,
          file_name: String(file.file_name || "").trim() ||
            safeFileNameFromUrl(fileUrl)
        };

        if (currentRow) {
          var currentFiles = parseEvidenceAttachments(currentRow);
          currentFiles.push(extraFile);
          setEvidenceAttachments(currentRow, currentFiles);
        } else {
          pendingBeforeFirstMatch.push(extraFile);

      });

      if (pendingBeforeFirstMatch.length) {
        var fallbackRow = evidenceRows[0] ||
          (audit.ratings || []).find(function (row) {

        if (fallbackRow) {

          });
          setEvidenceAttachments(fallbackRow, fallbackFiles);
        }
      }

      return audit;
    }).catch(function (error) {
      void 0;
      return audit;
    });

  function safeFileNameFromUrl(url) {
    var value = String(url || "");
    if (!value) return "";

    try {

      value = value.split("?")[0];

  function parseEvidenceAttachments(row) {
    var attachments = [];
    var raw = row && (
      row.custom_evidence_attachments_json ||
      row.evidence_attachments_json ||
      ""
    );

    if (Array.isArray(row && row.evidence_attachments)) {
      attachments = row.evidence_attachments.slice();
    } else if (raw) {
      try {
        var parsed = typeof raw === "string"
          ? JSON.parse(raw)
          : raw;
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) attachments = parsed;
      } catch (error) {
        void 0;
      }
    }

    attachments = attachments.map(function (item) {
      if (typeof item === "string") {
        return {
          file_url: String(item || "").trim(),
          file_name: safeFileNameFromUrl(item)
        };
      }

      var fileUrl = String(
        item && (item.file_url || item.url) || ""
      ).trim();

      return {
        file_url: fileUrl,
        file_name: String(
          item && (item.file_name || item.name) || ""
        ).trim() || safeFileNameFromUrl(fileUrl)
      };
    }).filter(function (item) {
      return !!item.file_url;
    });

    var legacyUrl = String(
      row && row.evidence_attachment || ""
    ).trim();

    if (
      legacyUrl &&
      !attachments.some(function (item) {
        return item.file_url === legacyUrl;
      })
    ) {
      attachments.unshift({
        file_url: legacyUrl,
        file_name: String(
          row && row.evidence_filename || ""
        ).trim() || safeFileNameFromUrl(legacyUrl)
      });
    }

    var seen = {};
    return attachments.filter(function (item) {
      if (seen[item.file_url]) return false;
      seen[item.file_url] = true;
      return true;
    });
  }

  function setEvidenceAttachments(row, attachments) {
    if (!row) return [];

    var clean = (attachments || []).map(function (item) {
      var fileUrl = String(
        item && item.file_url || ""
      ).trim();

      return {
        file_url: fileUrl,
        file_name: String(
          item && item.file_name || ""
        ).trim() || safeFileNameFromUrl(fileUrl)
      };
    }).filter(function (item) {
      return !!item.file_url;
    });

    var seen = {};
    clean = clean.filter(function (item) {
      if (seen[item.file_url]) return false;
      seen[item.file_url] = true;
      return true;
    });

    row.evidence_attachments = clean;
    row.custom_evidence_attachments_json = clean.length
      ? JSON.stringify(clean)
      : "";

    /* Keep the first file in the old Attach field for historical compatibility. */
    row.evidence_attachment = clean.length
      ? clean[0].file_url
      : "";
    row.evidence_filename = clean.length
      ? clean[0].file_name
      : "";

    return clean;
  }

  function uploadPrivateAuditFile(file) {
    if (!file) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error("Select a file first."));
    }

    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      return Promise.reject(
        new Error("Maximum attachment size is 5 MB.")
      );
    }

    if (!/\.(pdf|jpe?g|png|webp|heic|heif|docx?|xlsx?)$/i.test(file.name || "")) {
      return Promise.reject(
        new Error(
          "Allowed files: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, HEIF, DOC, DOCX, XLS and XLSX."
        )
      );
    }

    var formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file);
    formData.append("is_private", "1");
    formData.append("folder", "Home/Attachments");

    S.uploadsInProgress += 1;

    return fetch("/api/method/upload_file", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "X-Frappe-CSRF-Token": CSRF },
      credentials: "same-origin",
      body: formData
    }).then(function (response) {
      return response.json().then(function (payload) {
        if (!response.ok || !payload || !payload.message) {
          throw new Error(
            (payload && payload.message) ||
            "File upload failed."
          );
        }

        return {
          file_url: payload.message.file_url || "",
          file_name:
            payload.message.file_name ||
            payload.message.name ||
            file.name
        };
      });
    }).finally(function () {
      S.uploadsInProgress = Math.max(
        0,
        S.uploadsInProgress - 1
      );
    });
  }

  function auditCameraErrorMessage(error) {
    var errorName = String(
      error && error.name || ""
    );

    if (
      errorName === "NotAllowedError" ||
      errorName === "PermissionDeniedError"
    ) {
      return "Camera permission was blocked. Allow camera access in the browser and try again.";
    }

    if (
      errorName === "NotFoundError" ||
      errorName === "DevicesNotFoundError"
    ) {
      return "No camera was found on this device.";
    }

    if (
      errorName === "NotReadableError" ||
      errorName === "TrackStartError"
    ) {
      return "The camera is being used by another application. Close it and try again.";
    }

    if (errorName === "OverconstrainedError") {
      return "The selected camera is not available. Try switching the camera.";
    }

    return (
      error && error.message
    ) || "The camera could not be opened.";
  }

  function startAuditCamera(target, keepTarget) {
    if (!keepTarget) {
      auditCameraTarget = target || null;

    var modal = el("cameraModal");

        1

    auditCameraStarting = true;
    modal.classList.add("on");
    setAuditCameraStatus("Opening camera… Allow camera permission when asked.");
    stopAuditCameraStream();

    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      audio: false,

        },
        width: {
          ideal: 1280
        },
        height: {

    if (auditCameraStarting) return;

    var video = el("cameraVideo");
    var canvas = el("cameraCanvas");
    var target = auditCameraTarget;

    if (
      !video ||
      !canvas ||
      !auditCameraStream ||
      !target
    ) {
      toast("Camera is not ready yet.", 1);
      return;
    }

    var sourceWidth =
      video.videoWidth || 0;
    var sourceHeight =
      video.videoHeight || 0;

    if (!sourceWidth || !sourceHeight) {
      toast("Wait for the camera preview, then capture again.", 1);
      return;
    }

    var maximumWidth = 1600;
    var scale = Math.min(
      1,
      maximumWidth / sourceWidth
    );

    canvas.width = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.round(sourceWidth * scale)
    );
    canvas.height = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.round(sourceHeight * scale)
    );

    var context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    context.drawImage(
      video,
      0,
      0,
      canvas.width,
      canvas.height
    );

    setAuditCameraStatus("Preparing photo…");

    canvas.toBlob(function (blob) {
      if (!blob) {
        toast("Photo capture failed. Try again.", 1);
        return;
      }

      var timestamp = new Date()
        .toISOString()
        .replace(/[:.]/g, "-");

      var file = new File(
        [blob],
        "audit-camera-" + timestamp + ".jpg",
        {
          type: "image/jpeg",
          lastModified: Date.now()
        }
      );

      stopAuditCameraStream();

      var modal = el("cameraModal");
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove("on");
      }

      auditCameraTarget = null;

      uploadCapturedAuditPhoto(
        file,
        target
      ).catch(function (error) {
        toast(
          (error && error.message) ||

        );

      });
    }, "image/jpeg", 0.88);

  function grade(p) {
    if (p >= 90) return ["\u2605 OUTSTANDING", "la-grade"];
    if (p >= 80) return ["\u2713 EXCELLENT", "la-grade"];
    if (p >= 70) return ["\u2713 GOOD", "la-grade"];

  function isHTSection(section) {
    var code = String(
      section && section.section_code || ""
    ).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, "").toUpperCase();

    var name = String(
      section && section.section_name || ""
    ).toUpperCase();

    return (
      code === "S10" ||
      code === "10" ||
      name.indexOf("HT SURGERY") > -1
    );
  }

  function normalizedAuditTargetMax(sectionList) {
    var sections = sectionList || [];
    var containsHT = sections.some(function (section) {
      return isHTSection(section);
    });

    var originalMaximum = sections.reduce(function (sum, section) {
      return sum + (parseFloat(section.weight) || 0);
    }, 0);

    if (!containsHT && originalMaximum > 0) {
      return 100;
    }

    return Math.round(originalMaximum * 10) / 10;
  }

  function effectiveSectionWeights(sectionList) {
    var sections = sectionList || [];
    var originalMaximum = sections.reduce(function (sum, section) {
      return sum + (parseFloat(section.weight) || 0);
    }, 0);

    var targetMaximum = normalizedAuditTargetMax(sections);
    var result = {};
    var allocated = 0;

    sections.forEach(function (section, index) {
      var originalWeight = parseFloat(section.weight) || 0;
      var effectiveWeight = 0;

      if (originalMaximum > 0) {
        if (index === sections.length - 1) {
          effectiveWeight = Math.round(
            (targetMaximum - allocated) * 10
          ) / 10;
        } else {
          effectiveWeight = Math.round(
            (
              originalWeight
              * targetMaximum
              / originalMaximum
            ) * 10
          ) / 10;

          allocated += effectiveWeight;
        }
      }

      result[String(section.section_code || "")] =
        effectiveWeight;
    });

    return {
      weights: result,
      max: targetMaximum
    };
  }

  function activeSectionItems(section) {
    return (
      (section && section.items) || []
    ).filter(function (item) {
      return Number(item.is_enabled) !== 0;
    });
  }

  function sectionRawMax(section) {
    return activeSectionItems(section).reduce(function (sum, item) {

  }
  function computeAudit(ratings) {
    var activeSections = enabledSecs();
    var normalizedWeights =
      effectiveSectionWeights(activeSections);

    var out = {
      secs: {},
      total: 0,
      max: normalizedWeights.max,
      violations: []
    };

    function toNumber(value) {
      var numberValue = parseFloat(value);
      return isFinite(numberValue) ? numberValue : 0;
    }

    function normalizeRating(value) {
      var normalized = String(
        value == null ? "" : value
      ).trim().toLowerCase();

      if (
        normalized === "full" ||
        normalized === "full credit" ||
        normalized === "1" ||
        normalized === "100"
      ) {
        return "Full Credit";
      }

      if (
        normalized === "half" ||
        normalized === "half credit" ||
        normalized === "0.5" ||
        normalized === "50"
      ) {
        return "Half Credit";
      }

      if (
        normalized === "zero" ||
        normalized === "0"
      ) {
        return "Zero";
      }

      return "";
    }

    activeSections.forEach(function (section) {
      var raw = 0;
      var code = String(section.section_code || "");
      var activeItems = activeSectionItems(section);
      var effectiveWeight = toNumber(
        normalizedWeights.weights[code]
      );

      var rawMax = activeItems.reduce(function (sum, item) {
        return sum + toNumber(item.points);
      }, 0);

      activeItems.forEach(function (item, index) {
        var ratingRow = (
          ratings[code] || []
        )[index] || {};

        var rating = normalizeRating(
          ratingRow.rating
        );

        var factor =
          Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
            RVAL,
            rating
          )
            ? RVAL[rating]
            : 0;

        var points = toNumber(item.points);

        raw += factor * points;

        if (
          toNumber(section.is_critical) === 1 &&
          toNumber(item.is_critical_item) === 1 &&
          rating === "Zero"
        ) {
          out.violations.push({
            sec: section.section_name,
            q: item.question
          });
        }
      });

      var groupScore = rawMax > 0
        ? Math.round(
            (
              raw
              / rawMax
              * effectiveWeight
            ) * 10
          ) / 10
        : 0;

      out.secs[code] = {
        raw: Math.round(raw * 10) / 10,
        raw_max: rawMax,
        g: groupScore,
        max: effectiveWeight
      };

      out.total += groupScore;
    });

    out.total = Math.round(
      out.total * 10
    ) / 10;

    out.max = Math.round(
      out.max * 10
    ) / 10;

    out.pct = out.max > 0
      ? Math.round(
          (
            out.total
            / out.max
            * 100
          ) * 10
        ) / 10
      : 0;

    out.grade = grade(out.pct);

    return out;
  }

  function autoSaveCurrentAudit() {
    window.clearTimeout(S.autoSaveTimer);
    S.autoSaveTimer = null;

    if (S.busy || S.uploadsInProgress > 0) {
      S.autoSaveRetryTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
        autoSaveCurrentAudit();
      }, 900);
      return;
    }

    var branchElement = el("cBranch");
    var dateElement = el("cDate");

    if (!branchElement || !branchElement.value || !dateElement || !dateElement.value) {
      return;
    }

    S.busy = true;
    setAutoSaveBadge("Saving topic…", false);

    var branch = branchElement.value;
    var auditDate = dateElement.value;
    var rows = buildRows();
    var savePromise;

    if (S.editingDraftName) {
      savePromise = call("frappe.client.get", {
        doctype: "Branch Audit",
        name: S.editingDraftName
      }).then(function (existingDraft) {
        if (!canContinueDraft(existingDraft)) {
          throw new Error("This audit is no longer an editable Draft.");
        }

        existingDraft.branch = branch;
        existingDraft.audit_date = auditDate;
        existingDraft.auditor = S.user;
        existingDraft.audit_status = "Draft";
        existingDraft.ratings = rows;

        return call("frappe.client.save", { doc: existingDraft });
      });
    } else {
      savePromise = call("frappe.client.insert", {
        doc: {
          doctype: "Branch Audit",
          branch: branch,
          audit_date: auditDate,
          auditor: S.user,
          audit_status: "Draft",
          ratings: rows
        }
      });
    }

    savePromise.then(function (savedAudit) {
      return attachAuditEvidenceFiles(savedAudit.name).then(function () {
        return savedAudit;
      });
    }).then(function (savedAudit) {
      S.busy = false;
      S.editingDraftName = savedAudit.name;
      S.editingDraftBranch = savedAudit.branch || branch;
      S.editingDraftDate = savedAudit.audit_date || auditDate;

      branchElement.disabled = true;

      var newAuditButton = el("newAuditBtn");
      if (newAuditButton) newAuditButton.style.display = "inline-block";

      var saveDraftButton = el("saveDraftBtn");
      if (saveDraftButton) saveDraftButton.textContent = "Update Draft";

      setAutoSaveBadge("Auto-saved · " + savedAudit.name, false);
    }).catch(function (error) {
      S.busy = false;
      setAutoSaveBadge("Auto-save failed", true);
      void 0;
      toast(
        "Auto-save failed: " + ((error && error.message) || "See browser console"),
        1
      );
    });
  }

  function buildRows() {
    var rows = [];
    enabledSecs().forEach(function (s) {
      activeSectionItems(s).forEach(function (it, i) {
        var rt = S.cur[s.section_code][i];
        rows.push({
          section_code: s.section_code, item_idx: i + 1,
          question: it.question, points: it.points,
          is_critical_item: it.is_critical_item ? 1 : 0,
          rating: rt.rating || "",
          remarks: rt.remarks || "",
          evidence_attachment: rt.evidence_attachment || "",
          custom_evidence_attachments_json:
            JSON.stringify(parseEvidenceAttachments(rt)),
          action_owner: rt.action_owner || "",
          target_date: rt.target_date || null
        });
      });
    });
    return rows;
  }

  function saveAudit(submit) {
    window.clearTimeout(S.autoSaveTimer);
    window.clearTimeout(S.autoSaveRetryTimer);
    S.autoSaveTimer = null;
    S.autoSaveRetryTimer = null;

    if (S.busy) {
      toast("Please wait for the current auto-save to finish.", 1);
      return;
    }

    if (S.uploadsInProgress > 0) {
      toast(
        "Please wait until the file upload is complete.",
        1
      );

      return;
    }

    if (
      !el("cBranch") ||
      !el("cBranch").value
    ) {
      toast(
        "No active branch is available. Enable a branch in Control Panel.",
        1
      );

      return;
    }

    var rows =
      buildRows();

    var unrated =
      rows.filter(function (row) {
        return !row.rating;
      }).length;

    if (
      submit &&
      unrated
    ) {
      toast(
        unrated +
        " check point(s) still unrated",
        1
      );

      return;
    }

    S.busy = true;

    var branch =
      el("cBranch").value;

    var auditDate =
      el("cDate").value;

    var savePromise;

    if (S.editingDraftName) {
      savePromise = call(
        "frappe.client.get",
        {
          doctype: "Branch Audit",
          name: S.editingDraftName
        }
      ).then(function (existingDraft) {
        if (!canContinueDraft(existingDraft)) {
          throw new Error(
            "This audit is no longer an editable Draft."
          );
        }

        existingDraft.branch =
          branch;

        existingDraft.audit_date =
          auditDate;

        existingDraft.auditor =
          S.user;

        existingDraft.audit_status =
          submit
            ? "Submitted"
            : "Draft";

        existingDraft.ratings =
          rows;

        return call(
          "frappe.client.save",
          {
            doc: existingDraft
          }
        );
      });
    } else {
      savePromise = call(
        "frappe.client.insert",
        {
          doc: {
            doctype: "Branch Audit",
            branch: branch,
            audit_date: auditDate,
            auditor: S.user,
            audit_status:
              submit
                ? "Submitted"
                : "Draft",
            ratings: rows
          }
        }
      );
    }

    savePromise.then(function (savedAudit) {
      return attachAuditEvidenceFiles(
        savedAudit.name
      ).then(function () {
        return savedAudit;
      });
    }).then(function (savedAudit) {
      if (!submit) {
        S.busy = false;

        S.editingDraftName =
          savedAudit.name;

        S.editingDraftBranch =
          savedAudit.branch || branch;

        S.editingDraftDate =
          savedAudit.audit_date ||
          auditDate;

        toast(
          "Draft saved: " +
          savedAudit.name +
          ". You can continue now or reopen it from Review Audits."
        );

        renderConduct();

        return loadAudits();
      }

      return call(
        "frappe.client.submit",
        {
          doc: savedAudit
        }
      ).then(function (submittedAudit) {
        S.busy = false;

        toast(
          "Submitted: " +
          submittedAudit.name +
          " — " +
          submittedAudit.percentage +
          "%"
        );

        clearDraftEditingState();
        S.cur = blankRatings();

        renderConduct();

        return loadAudits();
      });
    }).catch(function (error) {
      S.busy = false;

      toast(
        "Save failed: " +
        (
          (
            error &&
            error.message
          ) ||
          "See browser console"
        ),
        1
      );

      void 0;
    });
  }

        if (messages && messages.length) {
          var parsed = JSON.parse(messages[0]);
          return parsed.message || String(parsed);
        }
      } catch (ignore) {}
    }

    if (error.responseJSON) {
      if (error.responseJSON.exception) {
        return error.responseJSON.exception;
      }

      if (error.responseJSON.message) {
        return error.responseJSON.message;
      }
    }

    return "Check the outgoing Email Account and email permissions.";

    if (S.busy) return;

    call("frappe.client.get", {
      doctype: "Branch Audit",
      name: auditName
    }).then(function (audit) {
      if (!audit) {
        throw new Error("Branch Audit record was not found.");
      }

      if (action === "verify") {
        if (audit.verified_on || audit.audit_status === "Verified" ||
            audit.audit_status === "Sent to Branch") {
          throw new Error("This audit has already been verified.");
        }

        successMessage =

          "ERPNext Notification will email the auditor.";

        return call("frappe.client.set_value", {

        });
      }

      if (action === "send_branch") {
        if (audit.sent_to_branch_on || audit.audit_status === "Sent to Branch") {
          throw new Error("This audit has already been sent to the branch.");
        }

        if (!audit.branch) {
          throw new Error("Branch is missing in this audit.");
        }

        return resolveBranchUserEmail(
          audit.branch
        ).then(function (branchEmail) {

          /*
           * Send the email first. Only after ERPNext confirms the email
           * operation, save all branch-action fields together in one update.
           * This prevents remarks from being lost between separate saves.
           */
          return call(
            "frappe.core.doctype.communication.email.make",
            {
              doctype: "Branch Audit",
              name: auditName,
              recipients: branchEmail,
              subject:
                "Branch Audit Report " + auditName +
                " — " + audit.branch +
                " — " + (parseFloat(audit.percentage) || 0) + "%",
              content: buildBranchAuditEmail(
                audit,
                remarks || ""
              ),
              communication_medium: "Email",
              send_email: 1,
              now: 1
            }
          ).then(function (mailResult) {
            if (
              mailResult &&
              mailResult.emails_not_sent_to

              throw new Error(
                "Email was not sent to: " +
                mailResult.emails_not_sent_to
              );

            return call("frappe.client.set_value", {
              doctype: "Branch Audit",
              name: auditName,

            });

            successMessage =
              audit.branch + " audit report emailed successfully to " +
              branchEmail + ". Remarks saved and locked.";
          });
        });
      }

      throw new Error("Invalid audit action.");
    }).then(function () {

  function normalizeRatingForReport(value) {

  function gradeNameFromPercentage(percentage) {
    var pct = parseFloat(percentage) || 0;

    if (pct >= 90) return "OUTSTANDING";
    if (pct >= 80) return "EXCELLENT";
    if (pct >= 70) return "GOOD";
    if (pct >= 60) return "AVERAGE";

    return "NEEDS IMMEDIATE ACTION";
  }

  /*
   * Recalculate every section from the saved checklist ratings.
   *
   * Formula:
   * earned raw points / section raw max × section weighted max
   *
   * Example for Section 01:
   * earned raw / 174 × 25
   */
  function recalculateAuditForReport(audit) {
    var ratings =
      (audit && audit.ratings) || [];

    var savedScoreMap = {};

    (
      (audit && audit.section_scores) || []
    ).forEach(function (row) {
      savedScoreMap[
        String(row.section_code || "")
      ] = row;
    });

    var ratingsBySection = {};

    ratings.forEach(function (row) {
      var code = String(
        row.section_code || ""
      );

      if (!ratingsBySection[code]) {
        ratingsBySection[code] = [];
      }

      ratingsBySection[code].push(row);
    });

    /*
     * Include currently enabled sections for new audits.
     * Also retain sections already present in historical audit rows.
     */
    var reportSections = S.secs.filter(function (section) {
      var code = String(
        section.section_code || ""
      );

      return (
        Number(section.is_enabled) === 1 ||
        !!ratingsBySection[code] ||
        !!savedScoreMap[code]
      );
    });

    var normalizedWeights =
      effectiveSectionWeights(reportSections);

    var recalculatedRows = [];
    var total = 0;

    reportSections.forEach(function (section) {
      var code = String(
        section.section_code || ""
      );

      var sectionRatings =
        ratingsBySection[code] || [];

      var effectiveWeight =
        parseFloat(
          normalizedWeights.weights[code]
        ) || 0;

      var rawMax = 0;
      var raw = 0;

      if (sectionRatings.length) {
        sectionRatings.forEach(function (row) {
          var rating =
            normalizeRatingForReport(
              row.rating
            );

          var multiplier =
            Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
              RVAL,
              rating
            )
              ? RVAL[rating]
              : 0;

          var points =
            parseFloat(row.points) || 0;

          raw += multiplier * points;
          rawMax += points;
        });
      } else {
        var savedRow =
          savedScoreMap[code] || {};

        raw =
          parseFloat(savedRow.raw) || 0;

        rawMax =
          parseFloat(savedRow.raw_max) ||
          sectionRawMax(section);
      }

      var groupScore = rawMax > 0
        ? Math.round(
            (
              raw
              / rawMax
              * effectiveWeight
            ) * 10
          ) / 10
        : 0;

      recalculatedRows.push({
        section_code: code,
        section_name: section.section_name,
        raw: Math.round(raw * 10) / 10,
        raw_max: rawMax,
        group_score: groupScore,
        weight: effectiveWeight
      });

      total += groupScore;
    });

    total = Math.round(
      total * 10
    ) / 10;

    var maximum = Math.round(
      normalizedWeights.max * 10
    ) / 10;

    var percentage = maximum > 0
      ? Math.round(
          (
            total
            / maximum
            * 100
          ) * 10
        ) / 10
      : 0;

    audit.section_scores =
      recalculatedRows;

    audit.total_score = total;
    audit.max_score = maximum;
    audit.percentage = percentage;
    audit.grade =
      gradeNameFromPercentage(percentage);

    return audit;
  }

  function operationalBranches() {
    var excluded = {
      "headoffice": 1,
      "testingbranch": 1
    };

    var preferredOrder = [
      "chandanagar",
      "srnagar",
      "madhapur",
      "banjarahills",
      "dilsukhnagar",
      "himayathnagar",
      "himayatnagar",
      "gachibowli",
      "kukatpally",
      "nellore",
      "vijayawada",
      "vizag"
    ];

    var branches = (S.branches || []).filter(function (branch) {
      return !excluded[normaliseBranchUserKey(branch)];
    });

    branches.sort(function (a, b) {
      var ak = normaliseBranchUserKey(a);
      var bk = normaliseBranchUserKey(b);
      var ai = preferredOrder.indexOf(ak);
      var bi = preferredOrder.indexOf(bk);

      if (ai < 0) ai = 999;
      if (bi < 0) bi = 999;

      return ai - bi || a.localeCompare(b);
    });

    return branches;
  }

  function branchCode(branch) {
    var key = normaliseBranchUserKey(branch);

    var known = {
      "chandanagar": "CN",
      "srnagar": "SR",
      "madhapur": "MP",
      "banjarahills": "BH",
      "dilsukhnagar": "DN",
      "himayathnagar": "HN",
      "himayatnagar": "HN",
      "gachibowli": "GB",
      "kukatpally": "KP",
      "nellore": "NLR",
      "vijayawada": "VW",
      "vizag": "VZ"
    };

    if (known[key]) return known[key];

    var words = String(branch || "")
      .trim()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .filter(Boolean);

    if (words.length > 1) {
      return words.map(function (word) {
        return word.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      }).join("").slice(0, 3);
    }

    return String(branch || "")
      .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, "")
      .slice(0, 3)
      .toUpperCase();
  }

  function ensureReportSectionsFromAudits(
    audits
  ) {
    if (
      S.secs &&
      S.secs.length

      return;
    }

    var sectionMap = {};

    (
      audits || []
    ).forEach(function (audit) {
      (
        audit.section_scores || []
      ).forEach(function (scoreRow) {
        var sectionCode =
          String(
            scoreRow.section_code || ""
          ).trim();

        if (!sectionCode) {
          return;
        }

        if (!sectionMap[sectionCode]) {
          sectionMap[sectionCode] = {
            name: sectionCode,

            section_code:
              sectionCode,

            display_code:
              sectionCode,

            section_name:
              scoreRow.section_name ||
              sectionCode,

            weight:
              parseFloat(
                scoreRow.weight
              ) || 0,

            raw_max:
              parseFloat(
                scoreRow.raw_max
              ) || 0,

            is_critical: 0,
            is_enabled: 1,
            items: []
          };
        }
      });
    });

    S.secs = Object.keys(
      sectionMap
    ).sort(function (a, b) {
      return a.localeCompare(
        b,
        undefined,
        {
          numeric: true
        }
      );
    }).map(function (sectionCode) {
      return sectionMap[
        sectionCode
      ];
    });

    var sectionFilter =
      el("mfSec");

    if (sectionFilter) {
      sectionFilter.dataset.done = "";

      sectionFilter.innerHTML =
        '<option value="">' +
        "All Sections (score columns)" +
        "</option>";

      if (!isBranchLogin()) {
        return lifeAuditOriginalLoadAudits();
      }

      var statusFilter =
        el("mfStatus");

      var fromFilter =
        el("mfFrom");

      var toFilter =
        el("mfTo");

      var sortFilter =
        el("aoaSort");

      var requestedSort =
        sortFilter
          ? sortFilter.value
          : "desc";

      return call(
        "life_audit_branch_access",
        {
          action: "report",

          status:
            statusFilter
              ? statusFilter.value
              : "",

          from_date:
            fromFilter
              ? fromFilter.value
              : "",

          to_date:
            toFilter
              ? toFilter.value
              : "",

          sort:
            requestedSort
        }
      ).then(function (result) {
        var resolvedBranch =
          result &&
          result.branch
            ? String(
                result.branch
              ).trim()
            : "";

        if (resolvedBranch) {
          S.branchUser = true;
          S.loginBranch =
            resolvedBranch;
        }

        S.audits =
          (
            (
              result &&
              result.audits
            ) || []
          ).filter(function (audit) {
            return (
              String(audit.audit_status || "Draft") !== "Draft" &&
              Number(audit.docstatus == null ? 0 : audit.docstatus) !== 2
            );
          });

        ensureReportSectionsFromAudits(
          S.audits
        );

        saveBranchAuditorNames(
          S.audits
        );

        S.audits.forEach(
          function (audit) {
            recalculateAuditForReport(
              audit
            );
          }
        );

        if (
          S.sel &&
          !S.audits.some(
            function (audit) {
              return (
                audit.name ===
                S.sel
              );
            }
          )
        ) {
          S.sel = null;
        }

        return loadMasterGrowthAudits()
          .then(function () {
            return S.audits;
          });
      }).catch(function (error) {
        S.audits = [];
        S.growthAudits = [];

        void 0;

        throw error;
      });
    };


  // ================================================================
  // OVERRIDE BRANCH MASTER REPORT FILTERS
  // ================================================================

  var lifeAuditOriginalPopulateMasterFilters =
    populateMasterFilters;

  populateMasterFilters =
    function () {
      lifeAuditOriginalPopulateMasterFilters();

      if (!isBranchLogin()) {
        return;
      }

      var branchFilter =
        el("mfBranch");

      var statusFilter =
        el("mfStatus");

      var auditorFilter =
        el("mfAuditor");

      if (branchFilter) {
        branchFilter.innerHTML =
          '<option value="' +
          esc(S.loginBranch) +
          '">' +
          esc(S.loginBranch) +
          "</option>";

        branchFilter.value =
          S.loginBranch;

        branchFilter.disabled =
          true;

        branchFilter.dataset.done =
          "1";
      }

      if (auditorFilter) {
        auditorFilter.disabled =
          false;
      }

      if (statusFilter) {
        var selectedStatus =
          statusFilter.value;

        statusFilter.innerHTML =
          '<option value="">' +
          "All Branch Reports" +
          "</option>" +

          '<option value="Submitted">' +
          "Submitted" +
          "</option>" +

          '<option value="Verified">' +
          "Verified" +
          "</option>" +

          '<option value="Sent to Branch">' +
          "Sent to Branch" +
          "</option>" +

          '<option value="Actioned">' +
          "Actioned" +
          "</option>" +

          '<option value="Closed">' +
          "Closed" +
          "</option>";

        var selectedStatusExists =
          Array.prototype.some.call(
            statusFilter.options,
            function (option) {
              return (
                option.value ===
                selectedStatus
              );
            }
          );

        statusFilter.value =
          selectedStatusExists
            ? selectedStatus
            : "";
      }
    };


  // ================================================================
  // BOOT
  // ================================================================

  var conductContainer =
    el("conductSecs");

  if (conductContainer) {
    conductContainer.innerHTML =
      '<div class="la-card la-empty">' +
      '<div class="la-spin"></div>' +
      "Loading…" +
      "</div>";
  }


  function ensureIdentity() {
    var identityPromise;

    if (S.user) {
      identityPromise =
        Promise.resolve(
          S.user
        );
    } else {
      identityPromise =
        call(
          "frappe.auth.get_logged_user",
          {}
        ).then(function (loggedUser) {
          S.user =
            loggedUser || "";

          return S.user;
        });
    }

    return identityPromise
      .then(function () {
        return call(
          "frappe.client.get_list",
          {
            doctype:
              "Has Role",

            parent:
              "User",

            filters: {
              parent:
                S.user,

              parenttype:
                "User"
            },

            fields: [
              "role"
            ],

            limit_page_length:
              0
          }
        );
      })
      .then(function (roleRows) {
        S.roles =
          (
            roleRows || []
          ).map(function (roleRow) {
            return roleRow.role;
          });

        return S.user;
      })
      .catch(function (error) {
        /*
         * Continue with the logged-in email even if the
         * branch account cannot read Has Role.
         */
        void 0;

        return S.user;
      });
  }


  function showOnlyAuditView(
    viewName
  ) {
    ROOT
      .querySelectorAll(
        "[data-view]"
      )
      .forEach(function (viewElement) {
        var currentView =
          viewElement.getAttribute(
            "data-view"
          );

        viewElement.className =
          "la-view" +
          (
            currentView ===
            viewName
              ? " on"
              : ""
          );
      });
  }


  function loadBranchMasterReport() {
    S.tab = "master";

    renderTabs();

    showOnlyAuditView(
      "master"
    );

    var masterTable =
      el("mTable");

    if (masterTable) {
      masterTable.innerHTML =
        '<div class="la-empty">' +
        '<div class="la-spin"></div>' +
        "Loading " +
        esc(S.loginBranch) +
        " branch reports…" +
        "</div>";
    }

    return loadAudits()
      .then(function () {
        updateIdentityLabel();

        renderTabs();

        showOnlyAuditView(
          "master"
        );

        renderMaster();

        void 0;
      });
  }


  function reloadAuditReport() {
    var requestedTab = S.tab;
    showLoadStatus("Loading audit reports...", false);
    return loadAudits().then(function () {
      if (S.tab !== requestedTab) return;
      if (requestedTab === "master") renderMaster();
      else renderAOA();
      showLoadStatus("", false);
    }).catch(function () {
      if (S.tab !== requestedTab) return;
      showLoadStatus("Audit reports could not be loaded. Please retry.", true);
      el("loadStatus").querySelector("button").setAttribute("data-act", "retryReports");
    });
  }

  function showLoadStatus(message, failed) {
    var status = el("loadStatus");
    status.hidden = !message;
    status.setAttribute("role", failed ? "alert" : "status");
    status.innerHTML = message
      ? '<span>' + esc(message) + '</span>' + (failed ? '<button type="button" class="la-btn la-btn-o" data-act="retryBoot">Retry</button>' : '')
      : "";
  }

  function bootAudit() {
    showLoadStatus("Loading audit workspace...", false);
    ROOT.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
    var workspace = ROOT.querySelector(".la-wrap");
    workspace.inert = true;
    el("tabs").inert = true;
    return ensureIdentity()
    .then(function () {
      /*
       * Resolve the logged-in branch before rendering tabs.
       */
      return detectBranchLogin();
    })
    .then(function () {
      updateIdentityLabel();
      renderTabs();
      showOnlyAuditView(isBranchLogin() ? "master" : "conduct");

      /*
       * BRANCH USER:
       * Only Master Report is visible.
       */
      if (isBranchLogin()) {
        return loadMasters()
          .catch(function (masterError) {
            void 0;

            S.secs = [];

            S.branches = [
              S.loginBranch
            ];
          })
          .then(function () {
            return loadBranchMasterReport();
          })
          .catch(function (branchError) {
            S.audits = [];
            S.growthAudits = [];

            renderTabs();

            showOnlyAuditView(
              "master"
            );

            renderMaster();

            void 0;

            showLoadStatus("Branch reports could not be loaded. Please retry.", true);
            toast(
              (
                branchError &&
                branchError.message
              ) ||
              "The branch report could not be loaded.",
              1
            );
          });
      }

      /*
       * HO, COO AND AUDITOR:
       * Keep all existing functionality.
       */
      return loadMasters()
        .then(function () {
          S.cur =
            blankRatings();

          var queryString =
            typeof window !== "undefined"
              ? window.location.search
              : "";

          var openCooApprovals =
            queryString.indexOf(
              "topic_approval=1"
            ) > -1;

          if (
            openCooApprovals &&
            isTopicApprover()
          ) {
            setTab(
              "topicApproval"
            );
          } else {
            setTab(
              "conduct"
            );
          }

          return loadAudits()
            .catch(function (auditError) {
              S.audits = [];

              void 0;

              toast(
                "Checklist loaded, but audit history could not be loaded.",
                1
              );
            });
        });
    })
    .catch(function (bootError) {
      void 0;

      var errorMessage =
        (
          bootError &&
          bootError.message
        ) ||
        "Check the browser console for details.";

      S.secs = [];
      showOnlyAuditView("conduct");
      renderConduct();
      showLoadStatus("Audit workspace could not be loaded. " + errorMessage, true);
    })
    .finally(function () {
      ROOT.setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
      workspace.inert = false;
      el("tabs").inert = false;
      if (el("loadStatus").getAttribute("role") !== "alert") showLoadStatus("", false);
    });
  }

  bootAudit();

})();
</script>
